'''Dharmadder''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Clangnaga]] at 36 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "What is karma exactly? Dharmadder knows it's not erasing the past, but making better choices for the future. When the mallet drops, the hollow echo can bring serenity to all listeners. Tap tap, Dharmadder's got plenty of patience."

Dharmadder is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat.

==Appearance==
A brown snake with a white underbelly and dark brown stripes. It has a golden bell for a head, and its body is wrapped around an ornamental device similar to a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pellet_drum pellet drum]. The drum is red, gold, and white, and there are red, flowing ribbons wrapped around the snake's body.

Dharmadder's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes red to blue and dark brown to dark green.

== Trivia ==
* Dharmadder was added to the game on 8/26/2026 alongside [[Snowcub]] and [[Lordopus]].
